official: 中野区議会議員及び中野区長の選挙における選挙運動の公費負担に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案一覧

name: 選挙ビラとポスターの公費負担限度額を改定
summary: 現在の条例では、選挙運動用のビラとポスターの作成費に、公費負担の限度額が定められています。この議案で、ビラ作成費の限度額を7円73銭から8円38銭に、ポスター作成費の限度額を541円31銭から586円88銭に改めます。改正後の限度額は、公布日以後に選挙期日が告示される選挙に適用されます。
changes: ビラ作成費の公費負担限度額を7円73銭から8円38銭に引き上げる
ポスター作成費の公費負担限度額を541円31銭から586円88銭に引き上げる
who: 中野区議会議員選挙・中野区長選挙の候補者
why: 公職選挙法施行令の改正に伴い、ビラとポスターの作成費に係る公費負担限度額を改めるためと、区長は説明しています。

en.name: Revises public expense limits for election flyers and posters
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Public Expense Coverage for Election Campaigning in Elections for Nakano City Assembly Members and the Mayor of Nakano City
en.summary: The current ordinance sets limits on the public expenses covered for producing election flyers and posters. This bill changes the limit for producing flyers from ¥7.73 to ¥8.38 and the limit for producing posters from ¥541.31 to ¥586.88. The revised limits apply to elections whose dates are officially announced on or after the date the ordinance is promulgated.
changes: Raises the public expense limit for producing flyers from ¥7.73 to ¥8.38
Raises the public expense limit for producing posters from ¥541.31 to ¥586.88
who: Candidates in Nakano City Assembly and Nakano City mayoral elections
en.why: The mayor says the limits on public expenses for producing flyers and posters are being revised following an amendment to the Order for Enforcement of the Public Offices Election Act.
